simple.summary: בֹּכְרוּ (Bôkᵉrûw) means Bokeru , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 8 38.

definitions.full: H1074. Bokeru בֹּכְרוּ proper name, masculine a Benjamite (on form compare מְלִיכוּ גַּשְׁמוּ, , & Ol § 107 near the end ; on Nabataean proper name in ו see Eut Nab 24, 25, etc. & Nö ib. 73 ff. ) 1Chr 8:38 = 9:44 .
